sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "size_options" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "color_options" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('CASHIER', 'MANAGER', 'OWNER')), "credential_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "staff_number" INTEGER NULL, "failures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lock_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "locked_until" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "counters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_first" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("lot_first" BETWEEN 0 AND 999), "lot_last" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("lot_last" BETWEEN 0 AND 999), "current_lot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_serial" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("next_serial" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (lot_last >= lot_first), CHECK (current_lot >= lot_first AND current_lot <= lot_last));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "style_markdowns" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "percent_bp" INTEGER NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NULL, "ends_before" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"), CHECK ((percent_bp IS NULL) <> (amount_paise IS NULL)), CHECK (percent_bp IS NULL OR (percent_bp > 0 AND percent_bp < 10000)), CHECK (amount_paise IS NULL OR amount_paise > 0));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cashier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "counter_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES counters (id), "opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("opening_paise" >= 0), "opening_count" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dues_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "received_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "cash_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("cash_paise" >= 0), "upi_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("upi_paise" >= 0), "card_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("card_paise" >= 0), "change_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("change_paise" >= 0), "applied_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("applied_paise" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (applied_paise = cash_paise + upi_paise + card_paise - change_paise));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "counter_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES counters (id), "cashier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "shift_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "customer_name" TEXT NULL, "customer_phone" TEXT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("total_paise" >= 0), "change_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("change_paise" >= 0), "billed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "counter_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES counters (id), "serial" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("serial" BETWEEN 1 AND 99999), "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" >= 1), "issued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "issued_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("counter_id", "serial"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cashier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "shift_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "approved_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "refund_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (refund_mode IN ('cash', 'upi', 'card', 'credit_note')), "credit_note_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES credit_notes (id), "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("total_paise" >= 0), "returned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dues_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('OWED', 'PAYMENT', 'RETURN_OFFSET', 'WRITE_OFF')), "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(NOT ("amount_paise" = 0)), "receipt_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES dues_receipts (id), "return_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES returns (id), "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "approved_by" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((kind = 'OWED' AND amount_paise > 0) OR (kind <> 'OWED' AND amount_paise < 0)), CHECK (kind <> 'PAYMENT' OR receipt_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind <> 'RETURN_OFFSET' OR return_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (kind <> 'WRITE_OFF' OR (note IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(note)) > 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "size" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "mrp_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("mrp_paise" >= 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("product_id", "size", "color"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("lot" BETWEEN 0 AND 999), "purchased_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batch_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches (id), "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES variants (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" >= 1), "unit_cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("unit_cost_paise" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("batch_id", "variant_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "articles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode_value" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(barcode_value) = 12 AND barcode_value NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'), "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES variants (id), "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches (id), "mrp_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("mrp_paise" >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('IN_STOCK', 'SOLD', 'RETURNED', 'DAMAGED')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "details" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "sent_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "article_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES articles (id), "barcode_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "mrp_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("mrp_paise" >= 0), "markdown_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("markdown_paise" >= 0), "discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("discount_paise" >= 0), "final_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("final_paise" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('cash', 'upi', 'card', 'credit_note')), "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_sequences" ("counter_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES counters (id), "year_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_serial" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("last_serial" BETWEEN 0 AND 999999), PRIMARY KEY ("counter_id", "year_label"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_note_uses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "credit_note_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES credit_notes (id), "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "return_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "return_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES returns (id), "bill_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bill_lines (id), "article_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES articles (id), "refund_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("refund_paise" >= 0), "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('RESTOCK', 'DAMAGED')), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_closes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES shifts (id), "closed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("counted_paise" >= 0), "expected_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "variance_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "count_detail" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_breaks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_break_ends" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "break_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES shift_breaks (id), "ended_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daybook" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('SALE_CASH', 'SALE_UPI', 'SALE_CARD', 'SALE_CREDIT_NOTE', 'REFUND_CASH', 'REFUND_UPI', 'REFUND_CARD', 'REFUND_CREDIT_NOTE', 'DUES_CASH', 'DUES_UPI', 'DUES_CARD')), "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(NOT ("amount_paise" = 0)), "ref_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ref_type IN ('bill', 'return', 'dues')), "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_staff_number ON users (staff_number)
